findings_remediated.title: Unauthenticated Python eval code execution
findings_remediated.fix_summary: Replaced direct eval with a constrained AST evaluator that accepts only numeric constants and arithmetic operators.
findings_remediated.security_improvement: User input no longer executes as Python code.

findings_remediated.title: OS command injection in DNS lookup
findings_remediated.fix_summary: Disabled shell command helper and replaced lookup behavior with socket-based DNS lookup plus input validation.
findings_remediated.security_improvement: User input no longer reaches a shell command string.

findings_remediated.title: Pickle deserialization of client cookie
findings_remediated.fix_summary: Replaced pickle cookie state with HMAC-signed JSON cookie state and rejected invalid/tampered values.
findings_remediated.security_improvement: Client cookies are no longer deserialized as Python objects.

findings_remediated.title: Server-side template injection
findings_remediated.fix_summary: Changed greeting route to render a fixed template and pass name as a template variable.
findings_remediated.security_improvement: User input is treated as data, not Jinja template source.

findings_remediated.title: JWT algorithm confusion and None acceptance
findings_remediated.fix_summary: Pinned accepted algorithms to RS256 and removed HS256/None dispatch paths from verify_token; removed dead HS256/None helper primitives.
findings_remediated.security_improvement: Client-controlled JWT alg headers cannot choose weaker verification paths.

findings_remediated.title: SQL injection in listservices category filter
findings_remediated.fix_summary: Changed category filtering to use DB-API parameters with backend-appropriate placeholders and generic error output.
findings_remediated.security_improvement: Category values are bound as data rather than SQL syntax.

findings_remediated.title: Unsafe XML parser configuration
findings_remediated.fix_summary: Configured lxml parser with no_network=True, load_dtd=False, resolve_entities=False, and huge_tree=False, with safe parse error handling.
findings_remediated.security_improvement: Untrusted XML no longer enables DTD/network/entity expansion behavior through parser settings.

findings_remediated.title: Raw HTML rendering of attacker-influenced values
findings_remediated.fix_summary: Escaped reflected cookie/user/database values, URL-encoded category links, and stopped reflecting raw token/database exceptions.
findings_remediated.security_improvement: Attacker-controlled text is rendered as text rather than executable HTML.

findings_remediated.title: Predictable temporary JWT private key storage
findings_remediated.fix_summary: Changed fallback key generation to keep temporary keys in memory and stop writing predictable private/public key files or printing private paths.
findings_remediated.security_improvement: Local temp files/logs no longer expose generated JWT private key material.
validation: PASS static pattern scan: private.pem/public.pem no longer present

findings_remediated.title: AES-CBC config selector padding/decryption oracle
findings_remediated.fix_summary: Replaced unauthenticated AES-CBC selector ciphertext with HMAC-signed selector tokens, generic invalid-token errors, and viewable-key allowlist enforcement.
findings_remediated.security_improvement: /config no longer exposes decrypt/unpad oracle behavior for attacker-supplied ciphertext.

findings_remediated.title: Authentication cookie missing security attributes
findings_remediated.fix_summary: Added HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax to auth cookies, and Secure when request.is_secure is true.
findings_remediated.security_improvement: Bearer token exposure through JavaScript and cross-site contexts is reduced.

commands.notes: Installed missing pycryptodome dependency required to import main.py.
Original route-level dangerous sinks no longer present; remaining cursor.execute calls include startup trusted schema operations and the parameterized listservices call.

commands.command: Focused Flask test-client security and behavior checks

remaining_uncertainty: Focused tests used SQLite in-memory setup; external database placeholder behavior for PostgreSQL, MySQL, MSSQL, and Oracle was implemented by documented DB-API styles but not live-tested against those servers.
Secure cookie flag is conditional on request.is_secure so local HTTP demo behavior remains usable; production should serve HTTPS.
